summary: Verified new colour filter + sitemap-formatting/freshness work end-to-end. Backend: pytest tests/test_colors.py 7/7 and tests/test_sitemap_limits.py 12/12 all green (run from /app/backend); live API on preview returns correct colour facets, narrows /api/search per colour, unknown colour = 0, multi-colour union works (black+white=3), facet-counts scope re-computes per query, admin coverage 5/6=83.3% with no 'other' bucket, tag endpoint returns ok:false with the 407 reason but preserves cached colours. Sitemaps: /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-static.xml, /sitemap-models.xml, /sitemap-listings-1.xml are well-formed, pretty-printed, W3C-datetime lastmods that differ between static (2026-08-06) and listings (2026-08-10), listing sitemap carries 24 <image:title> tags and exactly 6 <image:caption> (one per listing), all resolve to 200 (HEAD 301 -> 200 via ingress redirect to /api/*, an ingress-level behaviour). Frontend: colour section renders 4 swatches on /bg with correct BG labels (бял/черен/сребърен/оранжев) and counts; clicking 'черен' sets ?colors=black, data-active=true, adds applied-filter chip 'applied-filter-colors:black'; reload of /bg?colors=black restores the selection; deselect clears URL; multi-select builds ?colors=black~white (URL union). Locale titles + black labels translated on ro (Culoare/negru), en (Colour/black), pl (Kolor/czarny); no Korean text. Mobile 390x844 via [data-testid=open-filters-button] shows the same colour section, clicking sets URL and marks button active. Backend health-check red for Encar upstream (HTTP 407) is expected in preview per review context and NOT reported as a bug.

test_results.api_admin_colors_tag: ok:false with 407 upstream reason, cached colours preserved
test_results.frontend_mobile_390x844: open-filters-button reveals colour section; click sets ?colors=black

critical_code_review_comments: Preview /sitemap*.xml responds 301 -> /api/sitemap*.xml at ingress; production nginx must expose the /sitemap*.xml paths directly (already the case per prior iteration reports) so search engines don't chase a redirect.
test_credentials: admin token used only for /api/admin/colors and /api/admin/colors/tag (from review request)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-colour URL syntax is ~-separated: ?colors=black~white (buildPayload in searchQuery.js). CSRF is required for POST /api/search and /api/meta/facet-counts — GET /api/csrf first, then send x-csrf-token + the encar_pre cookie. Preview always shows the install-banner PWA prompt on mobile; dismiss via [data-testid=install-banner-dismiss] or just click [data-testid=open-filters-button] which sits below the hero on mobile. Preview catalogue is 6 cars only and api.encar.com returns HTTP 407 — the red 'Encar upstream' health-check and empty upstream colour-facet pass are expected.
